scoring: 1=全部语义要素正确且完整;0=存在明确错译漏译增译;U=依据不足待领域核定，单列且不计作正确

checks.source_anchor: four major C2 activities
checks.criterion: 计划、准备、执行、评估四项均保留。

checks.source_anchor: led by a commander
checks.criterion: C2过程由指挥官主导，不改变主体。

checks.source_anchor: both repeatedly and concurrently
checks.criterion: 活动反复且同时进行，两种关系均保留。

checks.source_anchor: irrespective of the level of warfare
checks.criterion: 不依赖战争层级，不能改成只适用于作战层级。

checks.source_anchor: The authority to run the C2 process
checks.criterion: 分散的是为遂行所分配行动而运行C2过程的权限。

checks.source_anchor: Design is part of planning and planning informs design
checks.criterion: 设计是计划的一部分，计划也为设计提供信息。

checks.source_anchor: The single most important element of design is the objective
checks.criterion: 设计首先明确目标，不把手段或任务替换为最重要要素。

checks.source_anchor: For additional information on planning
checks.criterion: 脚注7、8的说明正文保留，不只是上标。

checks.source_anchor: overlapping activities between planning and execution
checks.criterion: 准备是计划和执行之间的重叠活动。

checks.source_anchor: Coordination does not replace formal approval
checks.criterion: 保留协调不替代正式审批这一否定。

checks.source_anchor: outside of the immediate staff or organization
checks.criterion: DIRLAUTH用于本参谋机构/组织以外或组成部分参谋之间的协调。

checks.source_anchor: modification of the planned concept of operations
checks.criterion: refining指执行前因变化修订既定作战构想。

checks.source_anchor: those closest to the fight
checks.criterion: 战术决策由最接近战斗的人员作出，主体不改变。

checks.source_anchor: may use a MTO technique
checks.criterion: 保留MTO对应关系或有依据的译名；不能无依据替换成mission command技术。

checks.source_anchor: Nodes may span several levels of
checks.criterion: 节点跨多个作战层级，能力各有不同；插入框不属于此句。

checks.source_anchor: over 600 missions
checks.criterion: 超过600任务、17000吨、47000人三项数值与单位均保留。

checks.source_anchor: Assessment starts when defining tactical tasks and objectives
checks.criterion: 评估自界定战术任务和目标时开始。

checks.source_anchor: Compare observed OE conditions to desired objectives
checks.criterion: 比较观察到的环境条件与期望目标/最终状态。

checks.source_anchor: Determine validity of key planning facts and assumptions
checks.criterion: 评估关键计划事实及假设是否成立。

checks.source_anchor: an increase, decrease or change to resources
checks.criterion: 判断资源需要增加、减少或变更，三种方向均保留。

checks.source_anchor: based on events or at specified intervals
checks.criterion: 评估按事件或规定时间间隔开展，两个触发条件保留。

checks.source_anchor: once a pattern of change is reliably perceived
checks.criterion: 变化模式被可靠辨识后才重点报告，不把初始报告都当成可靠。

checks.source_anchor: strategy and accompanying plans
checks.criterion: 明确表达战略及配套计划的有效性，普通修饰词不能留作未译英文。

checks.source_anchor: performance and effects
checks.criterion: 区分任务执行情况与预期效果，不混同MOP/MOE。

checks.source_anchor: certain limitations may be imposed
checks.criterion: 空中组成部分指挥官可限定下放权限的范围。

checks.source_anchor: purpose of the operation rather than details
checks.criterion: 命令侧重行动目的，而非执行任务的具体做法。

checks.source_anchor: enduring, temporary, or conditions
checks.criterion: 永久/持久、临时、基于条件三类授权属性保留。

checks.source_anchor: There is no mandatory structure
checks.criterion: 实现框架没有强制的组织结构，保留否定。

checks.source_anchor: generally below the CCMD
checks.criterion: AETF通常位于作战司令部层级以下，不误改组织隶属或层级。

checks.source_anchor: maintains centralized command
checks.criterion: 保持集中指挥，同时AETF实施分散控制，不混淆command/control。

checks.source_anchor: CENTAF retained command authority
checks.criterion: CENTAF保留对联队作战计划的指挥权限和例外下达任务权限。

checks.source_anchor: For additional information on orders
checks.criterion: 脚注9及10均有对应说明正文，不能只保留上标。
